name: tutorialflow
description: Turn screen recordings into accurate narrated software tutorials.

interface.shortDescription: Create narrated tutorials from screen recordings.
interface.longDescription: Inspect recording frames, create timestamped Roger narration, preserve source video timing, and return a tutorial MP4 and modern thumbnail.
defaultPrompt: Create the complete narrated tutorial from this recording. Use Roger and anchor separate narration_segments to visible keyframe timestamps; preserve the video timing and allow silence between cues.
Inspect this recording and draft a tutorial script for my review.
